study_identification_part.si_4_title: Capturing the Individual Deviations From Normative Models of Brain Structure for Depression Diagnosis and Treatment

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Dataset II is the Human Connectome Project (HCP; 510 HC participants; age range 22-36 years). Dataset III is the REST-meta-MDD Project (229 HC participants; age range 18-65 years; site 20). Dataset I is a local clinical cohort from two hospitals (Affiliated Brain Hospital of Nanjing Medical University and Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital), consisting of 187 depressed patients and 166 HC participants, which maps to MULTI-SITE (N>=2).
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "To construct the normative models, we downloaded phenotypic data and MRI T1-weighted data from the Human Connectome Project (dataset II; 510 HC participants; age range, 22-36 years) and REST-meta-MDD Project (dataset III; 229 HC participants; age range, 18-65 years; site 20)" ... "In dataset I, we enrolled 127 depressed patients and 110 healthy control (HC) participants from the Affiliated Brain Hospital of Nanjing Medical University as the discovery cohort. Additionally, 60 patients and 56 HC participants from Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital were recruited as an external test set."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Shao2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Participants, L35-L39

answer.HCP: normative model training (Dataset II; 510 HC for building normative models of GMV)

answer.REST-meta-MDD: normative model training (Dataset III; 229 HC for building normative models of GMV)

answer.MULTI-SITE (N>=2): clinical application: discovery cohort (127 DP + 110 HC from NBH) for classification/treatment analysis; external test set (60 DP + 56 HC from NDTH) for generalizability validation

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Datasets II (HCP) and III (REST-meta-MDD) were combined (n=739 HC) to estimate the normative models of GMV across the life span. Dataset I served two purposes: the discovery cohort for training depression prediction models and treatment-related analysis, and the external test set for evaluating generalizability.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we estimated an age-related normative model with datasets II and III (n = 510 + 229 = 739)" ... "127 depressed patients and 110 healthy control (HC) participants from the Affiliated Brain Hospital of Nanjing Medical University as the discovery cohort. Additionally, 60 patients and 56 HC participants from Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital were recruited as an external test set."

model-1.model-name: B-spline Bayesian linear regression for regional GMV

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative model was constructed using all 739 HC participants from Dataset II (HCP, n=510) and Dataset III (REST-meta-MDD, n=229). No explicit train/test split of the normative model is described; all 739 HC were used for model estimation. The 166 HC from Dataset I were not used in normative model construction but were applied to the model to verify its generality.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "for each brain region, we estimated an age-related normative model with datasets II and III (n = 510 + 229 = 739)" ... "the HCs in discovery cohort of Dataset I did not participant in normative modeling, but were directly applied to obtain the deviations from the normal distribution constructed via large samples from Dataset II&III."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Dataset II (HCP): mean 29.19, sd 3.50, age range 22-36 years (n=510). Dataset III (REST-meta-MDD): mean 39.34, sd 15.66, age range 18-65 years (n=229). Weighted mean = (510*29.19 + 229*39.34) / 739 = 32.34. Pooled SD = sqrt(((509*3.50^2) + (228*15.66^2)) / 737) = sqrt((509*12.25 + 228*245.24) / 737) = sqrt((6235.25 + 55914.72) / 737) = sqrt(84.33) = 9.18. Min age is 18 (from REST-meta-MDD range) and max age is 65 (from REST-meta-MDD range). Overall-phase and train-phase are identical because all 739 HC were used for model estimation with no explicit train/test split described.
